brief:
The Committee of Families of Political Detainees in the West Bank called on the Palestinian Authority to immediately release Moataz al-Bitawi, brother of slain fighter Qais al-Bitawi, Shehab Wire reported. According to the committee, al-Bitawi has been held by the Security Committee at Jenin prison since February 7 without disclosure of charges or legal proceedings.

The committee's call underscores ongoing tensions between Palestinian civil society groups and the Authority over detention practices. Rights advocates have repeatedly documented cases of individuals held in security facilities, and the al-Bitawi case represents one of several recent demands for the release of detainees whose family members say they have received no formal legal status or court appearance.
